decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The roof area of the extension shall not be adapted for use as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.REASON: D3

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 3 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification) no windows or other openings (other than those expressly authorised by this permission) shall be formed in the walls of the extension permitted.

Condition : 5 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed single store side extension, by reason of positioning, size, scale, design and appearance, is considered to be acceptable having due regard for the existing building, the site characteristics, and the immediate local area and street scene. The proposal would not be harmful to local visual amenity or the amenities of neighbouring properties. The development is considered to be in accordance with the relevant provisions of Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines), and ENV- H.6.4 (Alterations and Extensions), of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan (Adopted December 2003), and the Residential Extension Guidelines 2002 and Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Erection of  single storey side extension to house.
